_comment: A JSON instance document, NOT a JSON Schema: it carries class
names, base classes and status codes, which the schema generators
Do not edit by hand; `cargo xtask check-stubs` fails on drift.
Order is significant — a base class precedes its subclasses.
A type lists a surface only when that surface can express it and

errors.doc: Base of every typed host-services failure.
errors.name: HostServiceError

errors.doc: The host rejected the record shape or size (audit cap).
errors.name: BadRequestError

errors.doc: The per-workload audit emit rate limit is exhausted.
errors.name: RateLimitedError

errors.doc: The host could not answer (handler down, broker not ready).
errors.name: UnavailableError

errors.doc: The workload's `ExecutionPlan.services` did not bind the service.
errors.name: NotBoundError

errors.doc: The verb is not implemented in this build.
errors.name: VerbNotImplementedError

errors.doc: Any other typed broker error code.
errors.name: ServiceError

errors.doc: Connect, framing, or (de)serialization failure on the vsock path.
errors.name: TransportError

errors.doc: The request was malformed: unknown method or a body the verb rejects.
errors.name: InvalidInputError

errors.doc: User code inside the VM raised; a structured envelope was parsed.

fields.doc: Correlation id for the failing call.
fields.name: error_id

errors.name: RemoteError

errors.doc: Could not reach the substrate, or got an unparseable response.
errors.name: MvmTransportError

errors.doc: The workload declared msgpack but the SDK has no msgpack support.
errors.name: MsgpackUnavailable

errors.doc: The encoded request exceeded the payload cap, refused before any               subprocess spawned.
errors.name: PayloadTooLarge

errors.doc: No-VM dispatch was requested without a local function to               introspect. Python-only in practice: the mode itself has no               TypeScript form.
errors.name: NoVmIntrospectionError

errors.doc: A secret-shaped value was passed as a call argument under strict               mode.
errors.name: SecretInArgError

errors.doc: Heuristic flagged a secret-shaped value passed as a call               argument.
errors.name: SecretInArgWarning

errors.doc: A transport call fired inside an emit subprocess, where no live               microVM exists.
errors.name: EmittingContextError
